WITH stage_0 AS (
  SELECT class_uid, "device.hostname", message, "metadata.log_source", "metadata.uid", status_id, time FROM __nano_lake_source__
  WHERE time >= '2026-09-24 07:00:00.000000' AND time < '2026-09-25 07:01:00.000000'
  AND (((((((class_uid = 3002 AND status_id = 2)) OR class_uid = 1007))) AND lower("metadata.log_source") != 'audit'))
),
stage_1 AS (
  SELECT "device.hostname" AS "device.hostname", countIf((class_uid = 3002)) AS fails, countIf((class_uid = 1007)) AS procs
  FROM stage_0
  GROUP BY "device.hostname"
),
stage_2 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_1
  WHERE (fails > 0 AND procs > 0)
),
stage_3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_2
  ORDER BY fails DESC, "device.hostname" ASC
),
stage_4 AS (
  SELECT * FROM stage_3
  LIMIT 20
)
SELECT * FROM stage_4 LIMIT 501 SETTINGS max_threads=16, max_execution_time=300, optimize_read_in_order=0, optimize_aggregation_in_order=0
